title: Multi-sample VCF Review
description: Validate and review a bounded workspace VCF cohort with explicit sample metadata, depth/VAF/FILTER rules, mutation landscape, low-frequency calls, longitudinal trajectories, and auditable outputs.

tools.name: vcf_cohort_preflight
tools.description: Validate one uncompressed workspace VCF 4.x file and optional sample metadata. Return sample, record, alternate-allele, qualifying-call, annotation, recurrence, and threshold summaries before researcher approval.

metadata_path.description: Optional workspace-relative CSV or TSV with sample, subject, timepoint and numeric time_order columns.

tools.name: vcf_cohort_review
tools.description: Run an approved bounded multi-sample VCF review and persist variant, call, sample-QC, trajectory, JSON, manifest, and Markdown outputs without classifying somatic status, drivers, actionability, or treatment response.
